title: Corso recruited to the Army Foreign Technology Division
summary: UAPGerb tells of Corso recruited to the Army Foreign Technology Division, about 1960 at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um, Corso stated that in 1960 he was recruited to the US Army's foreign technology division.

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Philip Corso, a US Army officer. UAPGerb says Corso stated that in 1960 he was recruited, with a link to a man named Arthur Trudeau, into the Army's foreign technology division at the Pentagon, and points to Corso's military records as backing. The story matters because Corso is tied to claims about the Army handling unusual technology.
